# fishiris — self-contained FISH viewer container

One image, one container: PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB with exported FISH session(s),
the FISH viz server (all popup views + the fishiris landing page) and Grafana
with the T0 dashboard. Nothing to trace or process — data only. Built for
hosting on the group's server so a session can be browsed without the lab
machine.

*Generated by Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic), 2026-08-25.*

## Build (lab machine)

```bash
# 1. export the session(s) from the host PostgreSQL + the T0 dashboard from the host Grafana
docker/fishiris/export_session.sh fish_20260817_134427          # → docker/fishiris/data/<session>/*.csv.gz
# 2. build (repo root = build context)
docker build -f docker/fishiris/Dockerfile -t fishiris:r11 .
# 3. ship
docker save fishiris:r11 | gzip > fishiris-r11.tar.gz             # scp to the server, then: docker load < fishiris-r11.tar.gz
```

## Run (server)

```bash
docker run -d --name fishiris --restart unless-stopped \
  -p 8783:8783 -p 3000:3000 \
  -e PUBLIC_VIZ_URL=http://<server-host>:8783 \
  -e PUBLIC_GRAFANA_URL=http://<server-host>:3000 \
  -e GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<choose> \
  fishiris:r11
```

First start loads the CSVs into PostgreSQL (≈1–3 min for a 5 M-event session);
the database lives inside the container (add `-v fishiris-pg:/var/lib/postgresql/data`
to keep it across container re-creation). Then:

| URL | what |
|---|---|
| `http://<server>:8783/fishiris/` | landing page — select the session, *catch!* → Grafana T0 |
| `http://<server>:3000/d/adq49gh/t0` | T0 dashboard (anonymous viewer enabled; admin / `$GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD`) |
| `…:8783/components?session_id=…&axis=ros\|os\|gpu` | Layer B component graph (namespaces / executors / streams) |
| `…:8783/ft`, `/gantt-tid`, `/gantt-cb`, `/cb-stats`, `/component-links`, `/chord`, `/chord-axes` | popup views |

`PUBLIC_*_URL` are substituted into the landing page and the dashboard links at
start, so use the address the *browser* will reach the server at (a hostname or
the server's IP, plus a reverse proxy if you put one in front).

## What is inside

* `timescale/timescaledb:2.17.2-pg16` (Alpine) + `python3 py3-psycopg2 py3-networkx graphviz`
* `/opt/fish/postprocess` = `fish_viz_server.py` + views, `/opt/fish/site` = landing page,
  `/opt/fish/init_fish_pg.sql` = schema, `/opt/fish/data/<session>/` = one gzip CSV per table
  (rows of that session; generated columns recomputed on load)
* Grafana OSS tarball + `gapit-htmlgraphics-panel`; provisioning in `/opt/grafana/conf/provisioning`
  (PostgreSQL datasource with the host's uid `ffpcavwwh7gg0e`, dashboards folder *FISH*).
  Tempo/Influx panels of the host T0 are dropped at export (no Tempo here).

## Limits

* Data only: no LTTng, no nsys, no ROS — a new session must be exported on the lab machine
  and the image rebuilt (or its `data/` mounted: `-v $PWD/data:/opt/fish/data`).
* r11 (`fish_20260817_134427`) ships ≈ 1.7 GB of rows (5 M trace events, 1.4 M gantt spans),
  ≈ 200 MB gzipped in the image; first-start load needs that much free disk in the container.
